pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with jagged edge gradients. Spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the central flank and decreases in scale toward the posterior and lower limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways. Topological nodes are visible at the intersections of three to four pathways. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively uniform across the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Small, high-contrast dark silhouette attached to the lateral aspect of the mid-neck.
